title: hieracium murorum subsp. sylvivagum
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. sylvivagum, commonly known as wall hawk's beard, is a subspecies of plant in the dandelion family. It is a perennial herb that grows in rocky outcrops and walls, native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium murorum subsp. sylvivagum include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antiseptic properties.
